name: youcom-mcp
description: You.com's hosted MCP server for web search, URL content extraction, and cited research. Provides current web search results with citations, full page contents for supplied URLs, and one-shot synthesized research answers. An API key unlocks the full toolset; a keyless free profile (https://api.you.com/mcp?profile=free) offers basic web search with no credentials.

YDC_API_KEY.description: You.com API key (Bearer auth), required for the authenticated `http` installation. Without a key, use the keyless free profile installation (http-free) at https://api.you.com/mcp?profile=free for basic web search. Get a key at https://you.com/platform/api-keys.

http.description: Hosted You.com MCP server with API key auth (default toolset: you-search, you-contents, you-research, you-answer, you-balance, you-discover)

http-free.description: Keyless free profile — basic you-search with no API key required

tools.name: you-search
tools.description: Current web search with snippets, source discovery, and freshness or domain-targeted queries. Supports livecrawl for search plus full page content.

tools.name: you-contents
tools.description: Reads full content from supplied URLs or promising search results before relying on exact details.

urls.description: URLs to fetch and extract content from

tools.name: you-research
tools.description: One-shot cited synthesis: returns a concise researched answer with sources for queries that need multi-source evidence.

query.description: Research question to answer with citations

tools.name: you-answer
tools.description: Fast, citation-backed answers from real-time web results in a single call. Supports freshness, country, language, and domain filters.

query.description: Question to answer with inline citations

tools.name: you-balance
tools.description: Return the remaining credit balance (in cents) for the API key in use, to check usage or remaining quota from inside an agent workflow.

tools.name: you-discover
tools.description: Find the right You.com integration path (API, MCP server, SDK, docs page, plugin, or framework) for an agentic project, with pointed recommendations.

query.description: Description of the integration goal or agent project

examples.title: Web search
examples.description: Search the current web and get cited sources.
examples.prompt: What's the current stable version of Bun? you-search the web and cite sources.

examples.title: Read a URL
examples.description: Extract full page content from specific URLs.
examples.prompt: Read https://bun.sh/docs/install and summarize the install steps.

examples.title: Cited research
examples.description: Get a one-shot synthesized answer with citations.
examples.prompt: Compare vector database pricing models in 2026 and cite sources.
